name: zc_menu_colours

tests.name: the Menu has a tab called "Colors"
the Colors tab opens from the Menu
the Julius Live Terminal is on screen
choosing a Julius Terminal accent changes what is on the screen

detail.note: green minus red, over the Julius terminal's own rectangle. Wonderland's gold scores -0.15 on this and the green it was set to scores +0.74, so brightness cannot fake it.

tests.name: the Julius terminal and the AI Companion terminals hold separate accents
a Menu theme moves the Menu's accent surfaces
and leaves the body text where it was -- it does not tint every element

detail.note: the founder: 'Update the intentional accent surfaces WITHOUT making text unreadable. Do not indiscriminately tint every element.' This is the clause a blanket tint fails.
